grammarOverview.title: Grammar Overview (Cumulative)
grammarOverview.summary: Cláudio functions at B1 in extended conversation. Grammar is generally communicative and effective, but accuracy becomes less stable under cognitive load. The priority is contextual refinement toward B2.
focusPoints: Use discourse connectors to structure longer answers.
Improve consistency of tense and agreement while speaking spontaneously.
Reduce Portuguese-to-English transfer in complex explanations.
Prefer reformulation and recasting inside meaningful conversation over isolated elementary drills.

teacherFeedback.title: Teacher Insight
teacherFeedback.body: Cláudio's strongest route to B2 is intellectually engaging conversation. He already brings subject knowledge, strong opinions and critical reasoning to class. The next phase is to make the English carrying those ideas more precise, organized and automatic.
